activity_summary: The picture holds the plot on its peg by the tiring-house door. The entrances are in Garnish's hand. It holds no face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood at the door, and did not take the plot down.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: His hand on the entrances. He is not in the picture.

entities.name: Richard the Second
entities.context: Mentioned in The plot on its peg
